name: gstack
description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
one_liner: A packaged copy of a well-known tech CEO's personal AI coding setup — 23 specialist 'roles' (a designer, a QA tester, a release manager) that review and ship your code so a solo founder can work like they have a small team.
buyer: A solo technical founder or very small startup team who wants the discipline of a full engineering org without hiring one.
business_use_cases: A solo founder uses the design and QA roles to catch 'AI slop' and production bugs before shipping, without hiring a designer or QA engineer.
A two-person startup uses the release and security roles to run OWASP-style audits before every launch they couldn't otherwise afford.
A first-time Claude Code user adopts it as training wheels, using structured slash commands instead of an intimidating blank prompt.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid onboarding/customization: adapt the 23-role setup to a specific founder's stack and ship a tuned fork for a fee.
Run a cohort-based course teaching solo founders this 'virtual engineering team' workflow end to end.

steal_this: This weekend, offer a flat-fee '/qa and /review audit' service for indie founders: run the toolkit against their shipped product and hand them a prioritized bug/security list.
